instruction: Enable cross-platform synchronization with Microsoft Word Online so changes made in LibreOffice automatically sync to Word and vice versa.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Writer has no integration with Microsoft Word Online or any synchronization capabilities with Microsoft's cloud services. LibreOffice and Microsoft Office are separate, competing productivity suites with no built-in cross-platform sync functionality. While both can open .docx files, there is no automatic synchronization between the two applications.
